metadata.source: Integrated from cnhkmcp-templates.md, forum-templates.json, and BRAIN learn docs
metadata.note: These templates use only price/volume (pv*) and options (option*) datafields

templates.name: price_zscore_20d
templates.description: Classic 20-day price z-score - measures how far current price is from 20d mean
templates.rationale: Price deviations from recent average often mean-revert

templates.name: inverse_volatility
templates.description: Inverse trailing volatility - low vol anomaly
templates.rationale: Lower volatility stocks tend to outperform higher volatility ones

templates.name: overnight_gap
templates.description: Overnight gap return - measures price discontinuity
templates.rationale: Overnight gaps often reverse intraday

templates.name: volume_surge
templates.description: Volume relative to 20-day average
templates.rationale: Abnormal volume precedes price moves

templates.name: capm_residual
templates.description: CAPM residual - idiosyncratic return after removing market/sector beta
templates.rationale: Isolates alpha independent of systematic risk

templates.name: capm_beta
templates.description: CAPM beta - measures systematic risk relative to sector
templates.rationale: Low beta stocks outperform in stable markets

templates.name: price_momentum_xsec_ts
templates.description: Intersection of cross-sectional and time-series momentum
templates.rationale: Stocks strong in both dimensions continue outperforming

templates.name: return_mean_20d
templates.description: 20-day average daily return
templates.rationale: Recent average returns predict continuation

templates.name: return_vol_20d
templates.description: 20-day return volatility
templates.rationale: Recent volatility predicts near-term stability

templates.name: cap_decile_neutralized
templates.description: Neutralize alpha within market cap deciles
templates.rationale: Remove cap bias from any signal
templates.note: Replace alpha_signal with your actual signal

templates.name: volume_gated_signal
templates.description: Only trade when volume exceeds average
templates.rationale: Reduce trades in illiquid conditions
templates.note: Replace alpha_signal with your actual signal

templates.name: options_pcr_volume_gated
templates.description: Put/call open interest ratio only on high volume days
templates.rationale: Options sentiment more reliable with high stock volume

templates.name: price_reversal_5d
templates.description: 5-day price change, inverted for mean reversion
templates.rationale: Short-term price moves tend to reverse

templates.name: high_low_spread
templates.description: Intraday range relative to close
templates.rationale: Wide ranges indicate uncertainty or information arrival

templates.name: vwap_close_spread
templates.description: Close deviation from VWAP
templates.rationale: Close above VWAP indicates buying pressure

templates.name: momentum_66d
templates.description: 66-day (~3 month) price momentum
templates.rationale: Medium-term momentum is robust predictor

templates.name: rank_momentum_sector
templates.description: Relative momentum within sector
templates.rationale: Sector-relative strength persists

templates.name: ts_rank_returns
templates.description: Current return percentile vs own history
templates.rationale: Stocks at historical highs continue trending

templates.name: open_close_ratio
templates.description: Intraday price direction strength
templates.rationale: Stocks closing above open show buying pressure

templates.name: vwap_max_13d
templates.description: 13-day VWAP high
templates.rationale: Recent highs indicate strength

templates.name: winsorized_backfilled_pattern
templates.description: Standard data cleaning: backfill NaNs then winsorize outliers
templates.rationale: Removes outliers and fills gaps without introducing bias
templates.note: Replace field_name with any PV field. Constants (63 days, 4 std) are community standard.

templates.name: group_zscore_manual
templates.description: Manual group z-score calculation
templates.rationale: Standardize within groups for fair comparison
templates.note: Replace x with signal, group with sector/industry

templates.name: signed_power_transform
templates.description: Amplify extremes while preserving sign
templates.rationale: Makes tails heavier without destroying direction
templates.note: Use when signal has meaningful sign and you want to emphasize extremes

steps: 1. Clean data: ts_backfill, winsorize to remove outliers
2. Transform/compare: time-series (ts_*) or cross-section (rank, group_*) operations

usage_notes: All templates use only PV (price/volume) and options datasets
Common neutralization: MARKET, SECTOR, INDUSTRY, SUBINDUSTRY
Replace placeholder fields (alpha_signal, field_name, x) with actual PV/options fields
Combine templates: use cleaning patterns before momentum/risk calculations
Test across regions: USA/TOP3000, EUR/TOP400, ASI/TOP500, etc.
